Surface ripples shift and deform the broad reflected treeline band across the lower frame.

caption: The video captures a wide, tranquil lake viewed from a fixed vantage, its horizon lined by low forested hills in dark green and brownish tones, with a small pale-yellow house on the right-hand shore beneath a pale-blue sky streaked with thin clouds. The camera stays locked, holding the sky, hill silhouette, and house in fixed positions. The lower half of the frame is open water mirroring the dark treeline as a broad band of reflected shadow. Across the clip, fine surface ripples shift and deform this reflection. The thin wave lines and the smeared brownish patch waver as the water moves. The yellow house and its faint reflection remain constant amid this slow ripple motion.
